status.main_product: Agricultural data analytics and satellite crop monitoring services
status.scope_reason: The company provides AI-driven geospatial analytics, drone surveys, and satellite remote sensing tools for crop health monitoring and climate risk assessment.
status.evidence: According to the company's official website and active operations as of late 2026, Agrocast Analytics provides satellite crop monitoring, drone surveys, and AI/ML technical solutions from its base at the IIT Gandhinagar Research Park.

claims.claim: Agrocast Analytics reports that its proprietary AI models process high-resolution drone imagery to detect and count individual tree crowns with over 95% accuracy, as detailed on the company's official Forestry & Vegetation Analytics portal.

The company reports performing dam infrastructure transformation utilizing drone surveys, 3D modeling, GIS-based multi-temporal surveys, and change detection and monitoring pipelines, as detailed in an official company portfolio briefing.
claims.note: dam infrastructure transformation utilizing drone surveys, 3D modeling, GIS-based multi-temporal surveys, and change detection and monitoring pipelines

claims.claim: The company has developed WebGIS dashboards and geospatial applications that integrate Mapbox API, TURF, jQuery, Axios, and cURL libraries to allow user-selected farm coordinate data to be saved in a MySQL database and automatically fed into its machine learning algorithms for remote sensing insights, as reported in engineering project documentation from IIT Gandhinagar.
claims.note: WebGIS dashboards integration with Mapbox API, TURF, jQuery, Axios, and cURL libraries to save coordinate data in a MySQL database reported in engineering project documentation from IIT Gandhinagar

claims.claim: The company reports developing proprietary AI models that process high-resolution drone imagery to detect and count individual tree crowns with over 95% accuracy, as detailed on its Forestry & Vegetation Analytics portal.

The company's technical architecture utilizes a physics-guided machine learning framework integrated with satellite observations for evapotranspiration (ET) estimation and crop stress tracking, as documented in its technical publications.
claims.note: physics-guided machine learning framework integrated with satellite observations for evapotranspiration (ET) estimation and crop stress tracking in technical publications

claims.claim: Agrocast Analytics Private Limited reported an annual revenue of ₹3.26 Cr for the financial year ending on March 31, 2025, representing a 409% year-over-year growth rate from the previous fiscal year, according to regulatory insights reported by The Company Check.
claims.source: The Company Check & Tracxn profiles for Agrocast Analytics Private Limited

claims.claim: The company has served over 20 clients and managed more than 80 projects across domains including agriculture, irrigation, survey and mapping, and disaster management since its founding, as disclosed on its official platform ecosystem overview.
claims.source: Agrocast Analytics official website home ecosystem overview

claims.claim: Agrocast Analytics Private Limited partnered with DroneAcharya Aerial Innovations Limited, issuing work orders worth INR 70,80,000 for a drone-based survey spanning 242 sq.km. of the Dholera Special Investment Region (SIR) in Gujarat using fixed-wing VTOL drones, according to a DroneAcharya corporate filing reported by Trendlyne.
claims.source: DroneAcharya Aerial Innovations Limited corporate announcements and exchange filings

claims.claim: The company signed a memorandum of understanding (MOU) with a university in Malaysia for collaborative research, workshops, and consulting work in water resources management, as announced by the company's Vice President of Technical Strategy.
claims.note: Memorandum of understanding (MOU) with a university in Malaysia, and the statement from the Vice President of Technical Strategy
claims.source: Public corporate announcements and news databases

claims.claim: The company reports having over 20 clients and having completed over 80 projects across sectors such as agriculture, climate resilience, and water resources on its official platform (Agrocast Analytics).
claims.source: Agrocast Analytics official website homepage and service domains overview

claims.claim: The company disclosed an active, technical and operations team roster of 16 core members for its presentation at the 9th India International Water Week 2026, which included specialised roles such as AI/ML engineers, GIS & remote sensing experts, and full-stack software developers.
claims.note: The specialized roles such as AI/ML engineers, GIS & remote sensing experts, and full-stack software developers within the 16 core members list are unconfirmed in the event's public disclosures.
claims.source: AgroCast Analytics Pvt. Ltd. LinkedIn Post (September 2026)
